raw_text: Situation in Colombo deteriorating rapidly. Protesters have now blocked the main Colombo-Kandy highway at Kadawatha. Three buses torched near Pettah market area. Police requesting military backup. Hospitals reporting tear gas inhalation cases. Government spokesperson yet to address the nation.
